verses.1: As for the instructions regarding those who are holy, just as I commanded the churches in Galatia, so also you should carry out these instructions.
verses.2: On each Saturday, you should keep something as a treasure with yourself. This way, when the time comes, there will be no need for any arguments or disputes.
verses.3: And when I am appointed to this task, those whom you may have tested through the letters, I will send them to Jerusalem to carry out this mission for you.
verses.4: But if it is right for us to proceed along with them, then they will proceed along with me.
verses.5: I will speak to you when I pass through Makedonia. For I am indeed going through Makedonia.
verses.6: I will, perhaps, stay with you for a while, or even stay longer, so that you can report to me when I go ahead.
verses.7: I don’t want to see you again anytime soon. I hope that I can spend some time with you, if the Lord allows it.
verses.8: I will wait until the fifteenth day in Ephesus.
verses.9: For I will make it a great and active place of worship, and many people will come there.
verses.10: And if Timotheus comes, see that he approaches you without fear. For the work of the lord must be carried out as I have commanded.
verses.11: Let him not be punished for this. Instead, send him away in peace, so that he can come to me. I will accept him along with his brothers.
verses.12: Regarding Apollos, my brother, I have asked him many times to come to you along with his brothers. But he didn’t want to come now. He will come when he sees that it’s appropriate.
verses.13: Hurry up, stand firm in your faith, be strong, and hold on.
verses.14: I always want to do everything for your sake.
verses.15: I ask you, brothers, to remember that the house of Stephen is from ancient times. It was dedicated to serving the saints from those days onward.
verses.16: So that you too can make decisions regarding those people, as well as all those who work with them and cooperate with them.
verses.17: I am also happy that St Ephanas, Forthunus, and Achaeus were present here. They have fulfilled your promise.
verses.18: For they have atoned for my soul as well as for yours. Therefore, take care of those who are like this.
verses.19: The churches of Asia are taking over you. Many Akylas and Priskas are also taking over you, along with their local churches.
verses.20: All your brothers are competing with you. You have competed with each other in a holy competition.
verses.22: If anyone doesn’t love their master, then it’s unacceptable. I don’t agree with that at all.
verses.23: The grace of our Lord Jesus is with you.
verses.24: My love remains with you all in Christ Jesus.
